engine: Springs signature hero — a grid of photo tiles rotated as one rigid plane (~-9deg), bound by a colour multiply wash, drifting as one plane on scroll. Harvested from D_springs_walkthrough S1.

measured_teardown.tiles: ~9-12 photo tiles in a CSS grid (varied subjects: man-in-field, macro-leaf, water-ripple, forest, building, cat, etc.). Thin green gutters between tiles.
measured_teardown.plane: the WHOLE grid rotated rigidly ~-8 to -10deg (counter-clockwise) and scaled up so corners cover the viewport after rotation. Tiles do NOT counter-rotate.
measured_teardown.wash: a dark colour wash OVER the whole mosaic at ~55-65% (multiply) UNIFYING the disparate photos into one calm field. Solid colour bg behind.
measured_teardown.motion: on scroll the ENTIRE rotated plane translates up as ONE plane. Depth comes from the rotation (top-row vs bottom-row tiles travel different screen-Y as the plane moves) — a free depth feel WITHOUT per-tile speed.
measured_teardown.content: a giant serif title over the plane (e.g. bottom-right) + a small eyebrow.

tiles.default: from .rmh-tile children or a tiles[] array

scale.what: plane scale so corners over-cover the viewport after rotation.

wash.what: opacity of the unifying multiply colour wash over the mosaic.

entry: RotatedMosaicHero.init(target, opts) -> { tiles, refresh }. Markup: .rmh-stage > .rmh-bg + .rmh-plane(.rmh-grid + .rmh-wash) + .rmh-content. The engine lays out + rotates the plane, sets the wash, and scroll-drifts the plane.
law: transform (plane translate/rotate/scale) + opacity only; the wash uses mix-blend:multiply but it is BAKED INTO THE STATIC PLANE (the wash sits on the mosaic and the WHOLE plane transforms together — the blend is NOT recomputed over a separately-scrubbed surface, so it is the one allowed mix-blend spot, per the catalog note for P18). GPU layer on the plane. reduced-motion -> no parallax (static rotated mosaic). NO WebGL.
gate_mode: CURTAIN/SLICER (CURTAIN=1): a mosaic always shows many tile-renders at once (seam 100% is inherent, not a diptych bug); blank/jank/fps stay hard.
proven: lab: 12 QUADRO tiles, angle -9 (plane matrix 1.38/-0.219 = rotate -9 scale 1.4), green multiply wash 0.55, giant serif 'Власний спокій'. Parallax proven: plane Y 0 -> -121 on scroll (drifts up keeping its rotation). Gate (CURTAIN) PASS: 0 blank, 59.9fps, jank 1/685.
